opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000. Travel grants up to £2,000-£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications from individuals for personal projects are not accepted (though individuals with organisational backing may be considered). No funding for undergraduate or master's students or for student fees. Projects originating in the UK apply to the UK office; those in Japan to the Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding ('small grants') for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

deadlines.raw: 1 December (annual, for decision in March of following year)

amount.raw: Up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers, practitioners, managers, carers and others in health-related fields with an existing research record (or intending to establish working links between organisations / produce a publishable comparative study). Applicants should normally show an existing research record. Project must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference given to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration; early-career applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Awards (once a year) supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including the study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
